If we want to understand Knowledge, the purpose of Knowledge, Paradoxically, we cannot understand it through Excavation (Zooming, Analysis, Rationale, etc.)... Only when we zoom outward (Probing?, Telescope)

Example as applied action:

"If one wanted to learn to sing or make music, you could study all the Theory in the world. But the real ability is in building Automaticity of Knowledge; which can be discovered through experience, or recording."

This implies several variables:
- Automaticity is the Conversion of Conscious information into Muscle-Memory: Ability
- Theory is unjustified if it does not complete a "Terminus"
